description: Dataset loading through the Rust core: case records in JSON Lines and the metadata artifact. One metadata object and one records text form one load call. An invalid record names the line and the field. The oversized record is materialized by the runner as its note states, because the data is too large to embed.

metadata.name: Message support cases
metadata.sampling_method: Selected from reviewed development work. No prevalence claim.

valid.note: Two labeled records and one plain record. A record without a group forms its own group, and one without expected labels states none.
A trailing newline ends the last line and adds no empty line.
valid.records:
{"id": "message-supported-002", "input": {"prior_decision": "Ship on Friday.", "conversation": "We agreed to ship on Thursday.", "proposed_message": "We now ship on Thursday."}, "label": {"author_type": "model", "origin": "synthetic", "reviewed": false, "reason": "The message restates the agreed date."}}
